_comment: P05-02 — LIVE MARKET-DATA ADAPTER CONTRACT: LOCAL TEST-DOUBLE FIXTURES.
⚠ THIS FILE DOES NOT DESCRIBE A REAL PROVIDER.
`mocklive` is a SYNTHETIC TEST DOUBLE used to exercise the adapter contract OFFLINE.
It is NOT an issuance from the governed provider-identity register
(p05/fixtures/provider-register.json), which remains UNMODIFIED and still contains
exactly one issued identity: `localfix`. PG-1 governs real sources; a test double is
not a source and is not issued.
work only. ⚠ No live provider execution (D9 N-1). No provider is selected here.
PROHIBITED HERE AND ABSENT: credentials, API keys, tokens, secrets, endpoint URLs,
hostnames, account identifiers, vendor SDKs, vendor names (A-23, SP-1…SP-6, SM-4).
DETERMINISM: every value below is a fixed literal. No wall-clock, random or environmental
input. Repeated runs are byte-identical (P02 D-2, D-3).

_note: PI-1: `provider` is a program-internal stable identity token, never a vendor name.
PI-3/PG-1: NOT issued. A real live provider identity requires a governed register
issuance plus provider selection — and provider selection is NONE MADE (D9 N-1).

entitlementRequirements._note: P05-02 declares the REQUIREMENT shape only. No entitlement value exists: the entitlement matrix is EMPTY (EM-2) and populating it needs provider selection + P16 authority (EM-3).

credentialRequirements._note: SP-5: a credential REQUIREMENT, never a credential. The value is never present in this program. Secrets are P03 (P02 E-1); nothing is provisioned here (D9 N-1).

knownLimitations: SYNTHETIC TEST DOUBLE — there is no real source behind it and no acquisition occurs.
PIT mode not declared: PIT storage is P08, which is NOT_STARTED.
D02–D10 not served by this double.
No adjusted series: adjustment modelling is P08.
Per-record tenant/region governance NOT applied — OI-P04-03 OPEN, bounded by IB-1.
FIGI values are synthetic and carry no licensing or coverage claim — OI-P04-04 OPEN.
Passing conformance against this double is CONTRACT VALIDATION, not live-provider evidence.

_nativeVocabularyNote: LA-18 / A-19 / M-3 — every token below is PROVIDER-NATIVE and must never appear in a
canonical snapshot, lineage block, evidence record or contract-level error record.
The list is deliberately disjoint from the P05-01 local feed's native vocabulary so that a
leak is unambiguous rather than a coincidence of naming.

_note: A-13 — the DECLARED provider wire schema, validated BEFORE mapping, so a presence or type
violation of a REQUIRED element is E5, while a well-formed payload that cannot be mapped
⚠ REQUIRED vs OPTIONAL is a real distinction, not a convenience. An OPTIONAL element the
source omits is SILENCE and maps to availability NOT_PROVIDED (A-20 / NL-4) — it is NOT a
malformed response. Modelling silence as E5 would conflate a data condition with a contract
condition, which P02_ERROR_TAXONOMY §2 forbids. This mirrors the P05-01 local feed, whose
QUOTE_WIRE likewise declares only the required native elements.

_fieldMapNote: MD-1…MD-8 / MR-1…MR-5 — the mapping is DECLARED as data, inspectable without reading code.
MR-2: no heuristic, fuzzy or name-similarity matching is permitted.
VN-5 / PN-2: the provider's own market code (`mktCode`) is NEVER venue identity. `venueRef`
is therefore taken from the P04-resolved venue reference, not from the provider payload.

derivedFields._note: VN-1/VN-3/VN-5 — venue identity is MIC-based and comes from the P04 venue reference, never from the provider's own market code.

responses._label: well-formed LIVE quote, OPTIONAL size elements ABSENT → NOT_PROVIDED (never zero, never fabricated)
responses._note: The source said NOTHING about qBSz/qASz. A-20 / NL-4: silence is NOT_PROVIDED, never a zero, an empty string or a carried-forward value. They are OPTIONAL in the declared wire schema, so their absence is NOT E5.

responses._label: well-formed LIVE quote, OPTIONAL size elements explicitly NULL → NULL_ASSERTED
responses._note: The source EXPLICITLY asserted null. NL-1 distinguishes this from silence: NULL_ASSERTED ≠ NOT_PROVIDED ≠ WITHHELD. All three come from the accepted AVAILABILITY enum; none is invented here.

_absenceSemantics._note: The three distinct absence semantics, all drawn from the accepted P01 AVAILABILITY enumeration. Conflating any two is prohibited.
_absenceSemantics.ABSENT_FROM_PAYLOAD: NOT_PROVIDED — the source said nothing (A-20, NL-4)
_absenceSemantics.EXPLICIT_NULL_IN_PAYLOAD: NULL_ASSERTED — the source explicitly asserted null (NL-1)
_absenceSemantics.UNENTITLED: WITHHELD — suppressed by entitlement, carries an entitlementRef (EV-8, RD-1, NL-5)

entitlementFixtures._note: EV-6: the decision is evidence-bearing, so a ref is required.
EV-4: fail closed — no data, no partial data, no cached substitute.
Distinguishable from never-entitled in the audit record.
EV-8 / RD-1: entitled fields plus explicit WITHHELD markers. WITHHELD ≠ NOT_PROVIDED.
ABSENT status → DENY (EV-3). An empty matrix means nothing is entitled (EM-4).

negativeCases._note: CE-1: domain outside the declared capability. Pre-flight, before any provider call.
CE-4: granularity outside the declared capability.
CE-3 / A-24: mode is honoured exactly or the request fails. No mode inference.
E3 is a REJECTION, not quality:'unavailable' (RD-3).
E1 is the ONLY quality-bearing class: it yields a snapshot with EMPTY fields and quality 'unavailable' (ST-9).
E4 is retryable and is a rejection AFTER the retry policy is exhausted. Retry EXECUTION is P05-04 (NOT AUTHORIZED).
E7 is retryable; may degrade to E1 under policy, and any escalation must be RECORDED (R-11).
A-13: the payload violates the DECLARED provider wire schema. E5 before any mapping is attempted.
A required native element is absent (IC-5). Still E5 — presence is part of the declared wire schema.

P02_PROVIDER_MAPPING_RULES C-1/C-2: a monetary value whose currency cannot be established is E8 — never defaulted, never inferred from the venue. ⚠ The token here is deliberately NOT ISO-4217-shaped. See LA-31 and docs/p05/P05_02_OPEN_ITEMS.md BD-P05-02-05: a shape-valid but non-existent code (e.g. 'XYZ') is a real E8 case that a SHAPE-ONLY check does not catch, and the local double validates shape only.
P02_PROVIDER_MAPPING_RULES T-6: a provider timestamp of ambiguous meaning that cannot be assigned to a slot is E8. T-1: the five P01 times are never collapsed.
